historical_G42.conclusion: No old-data geometry benefit: same E45/60,11 additional DfalseE.

matched_coverage_gain.conclusion: Broader source coverage improved both classes against matched budget, but64gates still fail.

interpretation: Large qerror is associated with most residual mistakes. It may be a consequence of the same hard appearance/occlusion, not the cause of classification failure.
Even LE3 has residual false occlusion (original3 visible points; new3 visible+1hidden). Same-material cue specificity is not completely solved.
All finite source query coordinates and L stay unchanged. Selecting LE3 with GT would be evaluation leakage and would not solve the full task.

Paired COVER/NEAR uses the same physical registered corner but every finite VAL pair has different actual q; newmovement median1.985px,max203.263 and Ldelta max33.740. These are not fixed-q causal image comparisons.

next_evidence_step.priority: Saved-input reliability diagnosis before adding another trained head.
next_evidence_step.action: On fixed source TRAIN/held-out VAL, test whether existing input-only per-keypoint confidence, q8 shape/edge consistency and crop-validity facts identify unreliable queries. Report full cohort mistakes and uncertainty coverage; no GTerror at deployment and no private thresholds.
next_evidence_step.why: Residuals concentrate at high GT error, but current evidence does not show that this error is observable from deployed inputs.

broad_data_G42_assessment.status: Reasonable falsifiable follow-up hypothesis, not an evidence-established fix.
broad_data_G42_assessment.rationale: V137 broadens scale/view variation and improves both classes; G42 could supply actual native/edge context. The direct V133 matched negative result lowers confidence.
broad_data_G42_assessment.limits: A future matched G0/G42 comparison would need same broad data/full gates and originalq; no GT geometry, slot remapping or recrop. No new run/protocol proposed here.

query_reliability_auxiliary_assessment.status: Conceptually distinct, potentially useful only after input observability is established.
query_reliability_auxiliary_assessment.target: Reliability/uncertainty of original query, separate from semantic external visibility; never output corrected xy.
query_reliability_auxiliary_assessment.limits: GTerror may label source-only auxiliary supervision but cannot be an input or deployed gate. U/rejection must remain in original knownDE denominators and abstention rates. It cannot reinterpret all badq as occluded or claim pose/keypoint accuracy solved.

recommendation: Prioritize the saved-input reliability audit. Treat broad-data G42 and a separate reliability auxiliary as competing hypotheses, with neither currently selected or trained.
